topic: No Kids Zones (노키즈존): cafes and restaurants that bar children, usually under 13. National Human Rights Commission 2017 ruled a Jeju restaurant's blanket ban on under-13s discriminatory (Constitution Art. 10/11, UN CRC); recommendation only, no national law bans them. Jeju Research Institute count: 542 nationwide, 78 on Jeju (14.4%), highest per 100k. Hankook Research Feb 2023, 1,000 adults: 73% acceptable, 30s 81%. Jeju council ban ordinance (Song Chang-kwon) shelved May 2023 over business freedom and no legal basis; later a softer 'curb the spread and change perceptions' ordinance, Yes Kids Zone sign-ups (64 restaurants, Oct 2025). Seoul Kids OK Zone: 350 designated Dec 2022, ₩300,000 per shop for kids' chairs and tableware from 2023. KICCE 2025 report: 70.2% of parents check entry limits before going out. TFR 0.72 (2023), 0.75 (2024).
title: In Korea, Some Cafés Don't Let Kids In

slides.headline: In Korea, some cafés **don't let kids in**.
slides.note: They're called No Kids Zones. Most adults are fine with them.

slides.headline: The sign **on the door**
slides.body: Through the 2010s, 'No Kids Zone' signs went up on cafés and restaurants. Most bar children under a set age, often 13, even with their parents right there. Owners point to safety and noise.

slides.headline: No Kids Zones **counted nationwide**
slides.body: A Jeju Research Institute count found 542 across Korea. 78 were on the holiday island of Jeju alone, the most per person of any region.

slides.headline: **73%** say it's fine
slides.body: In a 2023 Hankook Research poll of 1,000 adults, 73% said No Kids Zones are acceptable. People in their 30s agreed the most, at 81%.

slides.headline: The state **calls it bias**
slides.body: In 2017 Korea's human rights commission ruled that a Jeju restaurant's ban on under-13s was discrimination. A few bad customers, it said, can't justify shutting out every child.

slides.headline: But it's **still legal**
slides.body: The commission can only recommend. No national law bans No Kids Zones, and owners say choosing their customers is part of running a business.

slides.headline: The island **that tried**
slides.body: In 2023 Jeju's council proposed a ban and shelved it over business freedom. A softer rule came later: slow the spread, change minds, and sign up places that welcome kids.

slides.headline: Seoul's **Kids OK** zones
slides.body: Seoul went the other way. Since 2022 it has marked cafés and restaurants that welcome children, 350 at the start, and pays each one ₩300,000 for high chairs and kids' tableware.

slides.headline: In the **lowest-birth-rate** country
slides.body: Korea's birth rate was 0.75 in 2024, the lowest in the world. Parents say the signs tell them kids are a nuisance. 70% of them check whether a place lets kids in before they go.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: A warm Seoul café interior at dusk, blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, some cafés don't let kids in.

They're called No Kids Zones. The human rights commission calls them discrimination, 73% of adults say they're fine, and the country with the world's lowest birth rate is still arguing about it.

Would a No Kids Zone fly where you live?
reply: Travel tip for families: before heading to a café in Korea, check its map listing or Instagram, where a No Kids Zone rule is usually posted. In Seoul, the Smart Seoul Map shows Seoul Kids OK Zone places, which want children there and keep high chairs ready.
fact_check: 1·2장: 노키즈존은 13세 미만(13세 이하로 쓴 보도도 있음) 아동 출입 제한이 흔함, 안전사고·소음 이유 (머니투데이 2019-05-05 팩트체크, 인권위 2017 결정 보도). 'often 13'으로 완화.
3장: 제주연구원 사회복지연구센터, 전국 542곳 중 제주 78곳(14.4%), 인구 10만 명당 11.56곳으로 최다 (서울신문 2023-05-25, 2024-12-09 보도). 조사 시점은 보도에 명시 없음.
5장: 국가인권위원회 2017년, 13세 이하 일률 배제한 제주 식당은 합리적 이유 없는 차별 (헌법 10·11조, 유엔 아동권리협약). 결정문 원문은 못 봄, 보도 다수 일치.
6장: 인권위는 권고 기관, 노키즈존 금지 법률 없음. 영업의 자유 논리는 2023-05-11 제주도의회 보류 사유와 같음.
7장: 송창권 의원 '노키즈존 지정 금지 조례안' 2023-05-11 상임위 심사 보류(영업의 자유·위임 근거 없음). 이후 '아동출입제한업소 확산 방지 및 인식개선 조례'로 수정(서울신문 2024-12-09, 제정 연도 보도마다 다름 → 'later'로만 씀). 예스키즈존 64곳 신청(2025-10-15 보도).
8장: 서울키즈 오케이존 2022-12-13 350곳 첫 지정, 2023년부터 업체당 30만 원 유아의자·식기 지원 (서울시 미디어허브).
9장: 합계출산율 2024년 0.75 (통계청 2025-02). 양육자 70.2%가 출입 제한 여부 미리 확인 (육아정책연구소 육아정책포럼 2025, 뉴시스 2025-08-03).
reply: 스마트서울맵에 키즈 오케이존 위치 (서울시 미디어허브).
